machineProofBoundary: Structural schema/reference/RDF/property-constraint validation and synthetic test expectation checking only; actual conformance needs accountable M16 assessment.
shaclValidation: A6 Core subset local evaluator; NOT an independent SHACL validation engine
assessmentIntake: Syntax, completeness and evidence-reference triage only; declared assessor judgement and evidence are not independently authenticated or verified.
historical: Source hash manifest and input digest, deterministic report, no mutation of prior assessment or repository files. Prior evidence/signoff requires external validation.
publication: A12 does not grant certification, policy approval, semantic authority, or Profile waivers.
